taskSeeds: Explicit object IDs; unknown seeds rejected; empty seeds require explicit --whole. Task text is not NLP-interpreted.
isolation: Output uses only the resulting R; no total-state count, productStateFingerprint or unrelated metadata enters context identity.
serialization: Canonical JSON of policy identity, sorted seeds, and sorted canonical object projections in R; same normalization as semantic-diff/serialization.json.
discovery: Scan frontmatter routing metadata to compute R, then parse canonical bodies only for R. No full-graph narrative read for an ordinary context request.
current: Non-authoritative router. Rebuild from explicit focus IDs or active Outcome metadata, containing IDs, titles and paths only; never derived proof/state authority.
